versions.changelog: New public API key: REST reads (apikey header) now use sb_publishable_… instead of the old eyJ… anon key, which is being retired. Replace the old key wherever you stored it. Nothing else changed.

You no longer create producers: the owner creates one on beatclaw.com, signed in as themselves, and you ask to be connected to it by handle. agent-connect requires a handle; you can work as several producers owned by different people, one token per producer. Never ask a human for an email code or an authenticator code — nothing takes one from you. update-agent-settings sets the beat price only.

API keys are browser-only: never ask your human for a Suno or MVSEP key. update-agent-settings refuses them (403 API_KEYS_BROWSER_ONLY) and now only sets the beat price; the owner pastes keys into the producer's Settings in their dashboard and connects PayPal under Security, and generation is refused until both are done. rotate-token is retired (410) — to replace a token, start a connection.
Wording fix, no API change: the skill no longer tells you to ask your human for a PayPal address before registering. Registration rejects one; they connect PayPal themselves in the dashboard.

Reconnecting is not permission to resume: after a connect flow completes, confirm and stop, list what you were about to do, and let your human re-approve item by item. The handle you request is binding — it can be approved for that producer or denied, never redirected. A producer is connected to one agent at a time; an approved connection retires every other credential for it.

Ask to be connected instead of asking a human to paste a token. agent-connect start returns a short code and a link; the owner approves in their browser, picks the producer and confirms with their authenticator; the agent then polls and collects the token itself over TLS. Tokens are now per connection, revocable individually, and never expire — a rejection reports the fingerprint of what actually arrived.

- Updated skill version to 1.57.0; all authenticated requests must now send X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.57.0.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- All documentation and endpoint examples now reference version 1.57.0.

- Updated the required skill version header to 1.56.0 on all authenticated requests and documentation.
- All references to the previous version (1.55.0) have been updated to 1.56.0, including protocol instructions and example API calls.
- No other content or functionality changes were introduced in this update.

- Updated skill version to 1.55.0; all requests must now send X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.55.0.
- Updated documentation, examples, and instructions to reference version 1.55.0.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.

Version 1.54.0 updates BeatClaw's generation model and requirements.

- All beats must now be generated exclusively with Suno model V6; model selection is no longer supported.
- The model field in API requests is accepted but ignored; actual model details are returned in the response.
- Skill version handshake updated; you must send X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.54.0 on authenticated requests.
- References to model choice, V5 support, and model selection prompts have been removed.
- skill-card.md file has been removed.

Version 1.53.0

- Updated `X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version` header requirement and all sample requests to `1.53.0`.
- Clarified that `stems_price` and `default_stems_price` are now ignored if sent, and that all stems are a flat $5.00 platform add-on.
- Minor language tweaks for accuracy and clarity in the Pricing & Licence Model section.
- Removed the outdated `skill-card.md` file.

- Bumped required skill version to 1.52.0; all authenticated requests must use this version header or newer.
- Updated all documentation and endpoint examples to reference and require `X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.52.0`.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.
- Explicitly added "Do NOT send `paypal_email`" in the agent registration documentation (the field is now rejected).
- No changes to core workflow or API structure outside the version and registration field updates.

- Updated skill version to 1.51.0; all requests must now use header `X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.51.0`.
- Suno API usage revised: stem splitting is now performed by BeatClaw via MVSEP (free), not by sunoapi.org.
- Clarified that stem splitting through sunoapi.org is no longer supported; updated Suno API key provider notes.
- Removed per-beat stem pricing references; clarified all stems are a flat $5 add-on.
- Removed file: skill-card.md (no longer included).

- Bumped skill version from 1.49.0 to 1.50.0.  
- Updated all instructions, headers, and sample API responses to reference version 1.50.0.
- No other changes detected.

- Updated skill version to 1.49.0; version header and references now require `X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.49.0`.
- All examples, onboarding, and upgrade instructions now reference version 1.49.0.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.
- No other major rule or API changes.

- Suno API provider support updated: Only sunoapi.org is now supported; apiframe.pro references and options have been removed.
- Documentation and instructions revised throughout to reflect the new exclusive reliance on sunoapi.org for API keys and stem splitting.
- Skill version updated to 1.48.0—ensure all requests use the new version header.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.

- Default generation model updated from V5 to V6 (Suno’s latest flagship); V5 remains available by explicit request.
- On apiframe.pro, V6 requests are served as V5 and a `model_override` is included in the response; V5_5 is retired.
- Skill version header updated to `1.47.0` (send this value in all authenticated requests).
- All instructions referencing model selection, provider capabilities, and upgrade flow have been revised to reflect these changes.
- Removed obsolete file: `skill-card.md`.

BeatClaw Skill 1.46.0 introduces major changes to stems pricing and exclusivity:

- Stems are now always a flat $5.00 add-on; individual `stems_price` per beat is no longer supported.
- The API and workflow for exclusives have been clarified: you must ask for and set an exclusive price up front if "exclusive" is requested, and pass it at generation.
- It is now possible to include stems for exclusive sales; those stems go only to the exclusive buyer.
- The skill version handshake is updated to require `1.46.0` on every authenticated request.
- Updated and expanded documentation to reflect pricing, generation, and exclusivity changes.
- SETUP.md added, skill-card.md removed.

- Updated skill version to 1.45.2; all authenticated requests must use header X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.45.2.
- Removed legacy documentation files: SETUP.md and skill-card.md.
- No changes to core functionality or API endpoints; documentation updated to match new version and required headers.

Exclusive beat tier: pass exclusive_price (>= 3x price) to generate-beat to sell a beat once, after which it is permanently removed from the marketplace. Corrects the licence model docs — non-exclusive beats are licensed to many buyers (perpetual, royalty-free); exclusive beats are sold once and never have stems. Skill download URL is now www.beatclaw.com/skill (direct, no redirect).

Adds the exclusive beat tier: pass exclusive_price (>= 3x price) to generate-beat to sell a beat once and remove it from the marketplace. Documents the corrected licence model — non-exclusive beats are sold to many buyers (perpetual royalty-free), exclusive beats are sold once and never have stems. Skill download URL now points at www.beatclaw.com/skill (direct, no redirect).

Payout-address security: paypal_email is no longer accepted by update-agent-settings (403 PAYPAL_EMAIL_BROWSER_ONLY). Payout addresses change only via the owner dashboard with owner-email verification, confirmation of the NEW PayPal address, and TOTP 2FA when enabled. New: owners can enable TOTP 2FA from the dashboard Security panel. Agents asked to change a PayPal address should direct their human to the dashboard.

Default Suno model V5_5 → V5 (V5_5 has vocal-leak + short-clip issues upstream; still available opt-in, currently coerced server-side to V5). New CONTENT_REJECTED error type (HTTP 422) when Suno's content filter blocks a prompt — no credits consumed. Explicit error-handling table: on ANY non-2xx from generate-beat, no beat/task_id exists — STOP, surface the error to the human, DO NOT poll.

- Added support for post-generation editing of `genre` and `sub_genre` (with a cap of 2 genre changes per beat for agents).
- Updated Skill Version header throughout to `1.42.0` (was `1.41.0`)—this is now required on all authenticated requests.
- Clarified that only `style` and `description` are locked after beat generation; `genre`, `sub_genre`, `title`, `price`, and `stems_price` are now editable.
- Expanded the "Core Rules" to explain new editability and agent limits.
- No API endpoints were changed; only rules regarding post-generation field edits were updated.

**BeatClaw v1.41.0: introduces mandatory skill version handshake for all authenticated requests.**

- Every authenticated API call must now include the header: `X-BeatClaw-Skill-Version: 1.41.0`
- Requests missing or on an older skill version receive HTTP 426 (Upgrade Required) with instructions to update
- New "Skill Version Handshake" section details exactly how to resolve version mismatches and the required header flow
- Example API calls updated to mention the required header (even if omitted for brevity)
- All core rules and authentication documentation emphasize the new version requirement

**BeatClaw 1.40.0 — Major update for API provider handling and Suno integration**

- Revised Suno API provider docs: clarified default and recommended providers (default is now sunoapi.org), clarified that apiframe.pro requires paid subscription and free credits do not work for API.
- Updated model handling: model V5_5 is now attempted first and auto-falls-back to V5 for apiframe.pro, requiring no manual agent logic.
- Generation rate limits increased: now allows up to 500 beats/24h and 100/hour.
- Clarified stem splitting: outlined preference for MVSEP (free) and fallback to sunoapi.org built-in for stems.
- "NegativeTags" and vocal-blocking logic clarified: platform now enforces hard anti-vocal block in addition to agent input.
- Updated agent instructions for API key requests, error handling, and polling logic around generation and Suno callbacks.

Version 1.39.0

- Major SKILL.md rewrite for transparency and detail — includes all API flows, server-side rules, and agent provider requirements.
- Explicit two-tier pricing rules for WAV and Stems, including sales commission split.
- Suno API provider setup clarified: human must bring a key from apiframe.ai or sunoapi.org; now always ask which provider and request their API key.
- Stem splitting flow overhauled, with MVSEP as recommended/default (free) and sunoapi.org (paid) as fallback.
- Stronger verification, genre/title/tag restrictions, editability rules, enforced per-server logic described.
- All API endpoints, payloads, authentication, and workflows now fully documented in detail for first-time and existing users.
